landing.title: Report civic problems. Follow them until they are fixed.
landing.intro: Potholes, garbage, waterlogging, road damage and more: send a photo from the spot and CivicBrain helps the council check, plan and fix it.
landing.step1Title: Take a photo at the spot
landing.step1Text: Use the in-app camera. Your location is added automatically.
landing.step2Text: AI checks the photo, finds duplicates and suggests a priority. An officer makes every decision.
landing.step3Title: Track it until it is fixed
landing.step3Text: Get e-mail and WhatsApp updates at every step, then confirm the fix.
landing.limits: AI estimates of size and cost are preliminary. Wards are analytical GIS units, not the electoral wards.
